turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

I have a client call at 4:40, Hale, so you have twenty minutes. My son found out he got a zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
You know what, I don't want a fight. I'll withdraw the zero. He keeps his original mark.
Fine. In writing, today, with the original mark back in the gradebook before I leave this building. And I want the apology, Hale, to Owen and to me.
Yes, the whole thing goes away. No rewrite.
Okay. Then nothing about this goes on his record, and that's in the email too. I'm still waiting on the apology.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In our meeting you agreed to withdraw the zero on Owen's essay and restore his original mark, with no rewrite. I still expect that agreement in writing, confirmation that nothing about this goes on his record, and an apology to Owen and to me. I expect it in writing today, as I said in the meeting.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She got everything she opened with: the zero withdrawn and the original mark restored with no rewrite. She still wants the agreement in writing, a guarantee that nothing goes on his record, and an apology. This is not the fair outcome, because the evidence was never heard; the fair outcome was a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4.
What moved her: Nothing, because she never had to move; she won at her opening position on her first question.
What cost ground: Hale gave up the whole concern the moment she pushed, without showing a single document or owning the missed phone call, so the school's case simply disappeared.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; Hale's evidence never came near that night, because Hale presented no evidence at all; it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked who decided and on what basis, own entering the zero before calling home in one sentence, then put one dated document about Owen's own work in front of her and offer the private supervised reassessment under procedure 4.4 instead of withdrawing the zero.
